name: Campingplatz Renken
beschreibung: Campingplatz Renken is located in Kochel am See in Tirol, Österreich, and is surrounded by an impressive mountain backdrop. The immediate proximity to the Kochelsee shapes the relaxed, maritime atmosphere of the campsite. The facilities are of a high standard and include modern sanitary facilities, a kiosk, and dining options. Both comfortable pitches for motorhomes and quiet tent sites under trees are available to guests. It appeals to a broad audience that appreciates the peace and closeness to nature, especially families and active holidaymakers. The clear lake water invites swimming and boat trips, while the surrounding mountains offer ideal hiking opportunities. Campingplatz Renken is therefore an ideal place for a relaxing holiday in the Tiroler Alpen.
